sections.st: Oncology Packaging Manufacturer India — Biopsy Device & Oncology Catheter Packaging, Cleanroom Class 8
leads: Trizen Packaging manufactures oncology packaging from our Cleanroom Class 8, GMP-compliant, ISO 9001:2015 certified facility in Vapi, Gujarat — custom PETG thermoformed packaging for biopsy devices, oncology catheters, radiation therapy devices, cryotherapy devices, and oncology surgical kits. Oncology packaging manufacturer from Vapi for oncology medical device companies and cancer surgery device manufacturers across India and for export.

Oncology medical device packaging covers a specialised range of high-value, life-critical devices — biopsy needles and guns, oncology treatment catheters, radiation seed holders, cryotherapy probes, and oncology surgical instrument kits. Many oncology devices are used in cytotoxic environments or are associated with chemotherapy drug delivery, requiring packaging material compatibility with cytotoxic cleaning agents and radiation exposure.

strips.title: Biopsy Needle Tip — Cutting Mechanism Must Not Contact Packaging
strips.desc: Problem: Biopsy needle tips and cutting cannulas are precision-ground cutting edges — any packaging contact causes deformation of the cutting edge, requiring device rejection. Solution: Biopsy needle tip clearance cavity — cutting mechanism suspended in clearance, no packaging contact on the cutting edge geometry.

strips.title: Cytotoxic Environment Compatibility — Packaging Material Must Withstand Oncology Facility Conditions
strips.desc: Problem: Oncology packaging used in chemotherapy and radiation environments must be compatible with cytotoxic cleaning agents and radiation levels used in oncology facilities. Solution: Medical-grade PETG with cytotoxic cleaning agent compatibility confirmed from oncology facility cleaning specification at brief stage.

strips.title: Radiation Seed Array Geometry — Precise Seed Position for Dosimetry
strips.desc: Problem: Radiation seed holder packaging where seeds are not in their precise geometric positions changes the seed array dosimetry calculation — the treatment dose delivered to the tumour may be incorrect. Solution: Precision PETG seed holder tray with individual defined position for each seed — seed array geometry confirmed from the dosimetry specification.

strips.title: Biopsy Needle Tip Clearance — Cutting Edge No-Contact Mandatory
strips.desc: Biopsy needle tip and cutting cannula geometry identified from device drawing. Cavity tip clearance zone — no packaging contact on cutting edge geometry.

strips.title: Cytotoxic Cleaning Compatibility Confirmed at Brief Stage
strips.desc: Medical-grade PETG cytotoxic cleaning agent compatibility confirmed from oncology facility specification. Material CoA per batch.

strips.title: Radiation Seed Holder Precision Geometry
strips.desc: Precision PETG seed holder tray with individual cavity position per seed. Seed array geometry confirmed from dosimetry specification before tooling design.

faqs.q: What oncology packaging does Trizen manufacture?

Cleanroom Class 8, GMP, ISO 9001:2015. Oncology packaging manufacturer from Vapi, Gujarat.

faqs.q: What certifications does Trizen have for Oncology Packaging?
faqs.a: ISO 9001:2015, GMP, and Cleanroom Class 8 (ISO 14644-1 — 100,000 particles/m³). All medical packaging components produced in the Class 8 cleanroom with full GMP batch documentation per production batch.

faqs.q: Is PETG compatible with EO sterilization for oncology packaging?
faqs.a: Yes — medical-grade PETG is compatible with Ethylene Oxide (EO) sterilization and gamma radiation sterilization. EO compatibility confirmed by material CoA per production batch.

faqs.q: What documentation is provided for medical device supplier qualification?
faqs.a: First article inspection report, dimensional inspection records per production batch, material CoA with medical-grade PETG specification per batch, batch records, ISO 9001:2015 certificate, GMP compliance documentation.

faqs.q: Why source oncology packaging from Vapi, Gujarat?
faqs.a: Oncology packaging manufacturer Vapi — Cleanroom Class 8, GMP, ISO 9001:2015. Oncology packaging manufacturer Gujarat for medical device companies. Medical packaging manufacturer from India for domestic and export medical device markets.

faqs.q: What is Trizen's scope for medical packaging?
faqs.a: Trizen manufactures the thermoformed PETG packaging component — the tray or blister shell. Device loading, Tyvek/foil lidding, heat sealing, and sterilization are performed by the medical device manufacturer. Clear scope for DHF traceability.
First article: 14 to 21 business days from device technical drawing or sample — cleanroom CNC tooling at Vapi. ISO 9001:2015, GMP, and Cleanroom Class 8 documentation per production batch.
